moat_against: Scale and ad-targeting disadvantage vs Meta/Google/TikTok — ad revenue only +9% in Q2 2026
Growth concentrated in low-ARPU Rest of World ($1.00) while North America DAU fell 7% and Europe 2%
No real switching costs — users multi-home, features copied within quarters, no GAAP profitability in ~15 years
Platform dependence on Apple/Google privacy and app-store rules
moat_for: Differentiated close-friends ephemeral-messaging graph with a loyal younger North America/Europe cohort
AR/camera platform depth (Lenses, creator AR ecosystem, Specs optionality)
Emerging direct-revenue leg with demonstrated willingness to pay (other revenue +85% YoY in Q2 2026) and <3% of monthly users paying — conversion headroom
moat_justification: Weak-to-moderate: a differentiated close-friends ephemeral-messaging graph with a loyal younger NA/EU cohort, AR/Lens capability, and a direct-revenue leg past $1B annualized (<3% of MAU paying), but scale and ad-targeting lag Meta/Google/TikTok (ad revenue only +9% in Q2 2026), all DAU growth is in $1.00-ARPU Rest of World while North America DAU fell 7%, users multi-home with no real switching costs, pricing power has never produced GAAP profitability in ~15 years, and Apple/Google platform rules sit in the middle.
name: Snap Inc
one_liner: Real, improving social platform, moat 4/10 — but SBC of ~$1.03B TTM exceeds all of its $919M TTM operating cash flow, so owner's earnings are negative in all 10 years of history (-$0.19/share TTM) and it cannot clear the 15% hurdle at any price on an OE DCF; at $6.49 you pay for SBC discipline that has not yet shown up in a filing.
